extension.summary: Runtime v3 Cobra player reboot, lock and Multi-View continuity contract.
extension.description: Reboots fullscreen Cobra playback around a video-first gradient layout, adds an Infinity-style input-blocking player lock with timed unlock affordance, preserves the mini-player session while navigating guide/category screens, and keeps existing Multi-View streams alive when adding or reflowing tiles. Native playback, renderer, rotation, Fold, background/resume and Infinity handoff ownership remain protected.
